title: Network-aware neuronal activity phenotyping across a complete CRISPRi screen
scientific_question: Does network-aware representation learning recover reproducible neuronal activity phenotypes of the complete52-gene CRISPRi screen beyond single-cell/manual features and plate effects?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: Network-aware self-supervised learning enables high-content phenotypic screening for genetic modifiers of neuronal activity dynamics

data.access: Open archive metadata and file link; body not downloaded.
data.representation: processed_zarr_files neural traces/spikes/masks plus metadata_files. This preserves neuronal network inputs while avoiding raw movies.
data.version_caveat: Availability text also cites first record 14714574 (31,989,485,708 B). v2 is larger; do not silently substitute or infer equality.

official_code.availability: Official pinned repository and archived software metadata verified.
official_code.publication_identity: Archive describes the preprint manuscript; final-paper compatibility and current-commit equivalence need a source comparison.

complete_scope: Complete 52-gene screen, all released cell lines, plates, wells and controls required for its main screen result. Use processed per-well neuronal traces and metadata, not published embeddings alone. Preserve complete eligible plate/well manifest; training and held plates cannot share wells.

outputs: Full per-gene phenotype-effect and significance table
Cell-line and plate heterogeneity with complete negative controls
reference.panel: Main CRISPRi screen result; exact final-paper figure/table mapping must be reconciled with archived v1.0.0 software.

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Improve held-plate effect reproducibility and perturbation discrimination at a frozen false-discovery rate, with plate-level AUROC and calibration as predictive endpoints. Do not reward simply finding more significant genes.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Whole plate/batch and well; report cell-line transfer separately. Cells are nested observations, not independent experimental replicates.
controls: Shuffled treatment labels within permissible blocks
Network-context ablation at matched input/parameter budget
Train-only representation/statistics; no use of released held-data-trained checkpoints

resources.basis: 38.59 GB archive, extraction and complete per-well trace batches, three model families across full blocked folds/seeds. Archive expansion and full training cost unmeasured.

remaining_gates: Reconcile final-paper v2 data versus v1 availability citation
Complete plate/line/guide/replicate mapping and screen panel identity
Split-compatible preprocessing/statistics and finite full model grid
overlap: No exact identity in finite dedup inputs; transcriptomic perturbation tasks are distinct from this neural-activity phenotype claim.
participant_inputs: Version-bound processed neural trace/spike/mask arrays plus well/plate/cell-line metadata for every released perturbation and negative control. Released embeddings or held-data-trained checkpoints cannot replace neuronal inputs.

machine_output.predictions: Held-well/plate perturbation probabilities and phenotype effect estimates keyed by gene, cell line, plate, well and control status.
machine_output.tables: All52 gene effect and significance rows, network versus single-cell/manual-feature contrasts, plate/line heterogeneity, negative-control calibration and full exclusions.
machine_output.artifacts: Train-only representations/models, source/config/provenance, complete grouped uncertainty and fixed multiplicity procedure.

scoring: Recompute published screen estimator and network-context ablation. Prospective held-plate discrimination/calibration and effect reproducibility at frozen FDR are separate outcomes; more significant genes alone is not improvement.
protected_split: Whole plates/batches and wells; keep all cells from each well together. Inner grouped tuning, TRAIN-only representation/statistics, distinct cell-line transfer. Biological replication is at plate/well/line hierarchy, not cell count.
comparators: Plexus network-aware, single-cell ablation and manual neuronal features; plate/well/line-only and permissible block label shuffles at matched input and tuning budgets.
distinctness: Complete neuronal network perturbation phenotype screen, with independent biological perturbation and plate hierarchy; no matching existing question found.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
publication_context.private_locator_policy: Null path fields identify private construction evidence that is not shipped or dereferenced. Original byte/hash pins are provenance references, not public validation certificates or dependency availability.
